benchmark_metadata.fixture_selection: nested lowest blake2b identifier ranks with seed contigger-shark-real-scale-v1
benchmark_metadata.platform: Setonix work partition; single Python process; Slurm allocation may include extra CPUs
benchmark_metadata.limitations: This measures only FASTA loading, catalogue construction, and candidate generation. It does not measure minimap2, graph construction, sequence output, or multi-assembly merge decisions.

interpretation.observed: Candidate time and retained-seed temporary disk scale close to linearly across these nested real-data samples. Candidate pairs and pair-evidence disk grow substantially faster than input contig count, so they remain the principal pressure metric.
interpretation.not_an_extrapolation: The 1m fixture is 4.3% of source contigs and bases. Do not extrapolate its 72-minute, 20.7-GiB process result linearly to the full collection: candidate-pair growth is data dependent and complete merging also adds minimap2, graph, and output costs.
interpretation.next_gate: Before a larger real merge, profile candidate generation at the next bounded size and retain --max-seed-pair-observations. Do not run an unbounded full all-assembly merge from this benchmark alone.
